queen_job.recipient: A technically literate founder, creator, researcher, or potential partner
queen_job.job: Understand FrankX in ten seconds, trust the authorship model, and choose one inspectable path
queen_job.promise: See how Frank turns questions and source material into reviewed research, architecture, guides, products, and partnership systems with bounded specialist agents
queen_job.required_understanding: Frank directs the work and owns the judgment; agents expand research, critique, synthesis, implementation, and verification capacity

directions.name: Public Workbench
directions.thesis: Lead with Frank, the source-to-artifact workflow, and current inspectable work
directions.differentiation: A human-led workspace whose division of labor is visible
directions.risk: Can feel procedural unless Frank's voice and real artifacts remain prominent

directions.name: Field Journal
directions.thesis: Lead with dated observations, personal essays, and the evolution of the work
directions.differentiation: A warmer editorial relationship with a visibly changing practice
directions.risk: The operating model and breadth of useful artifacts become harder to understand quickly

directions.name: Systems Observatory
directions.thesis: Lead with a visual map of architectures, agents, research domains, and outputs
directions.differentiation: A striking systems-level view of a large body of work
directions.risk: The interface can eclipse the person and repeat the site's existing complexity

decision.reason: It best explains who is responsible, what the agents do, what visitors can inspect, and where to act without reducing FrankX to an agency or content machine.

findings: The first viewport did not show Frank or the source-to-artifact workflow
An eager third-party music embed occupied high-value hero space
The top-level navigation presented too many competing doors

mobile.reason: Responsive release evidence must be captured from the deployed preview before production merge
